stem: Which statement best explains why this resolution was adopted?

options.label: F
options.text: Colonists were upset by the punishment imposed after the Boston Tea Party.

options.label: G
options.text: Colonists created this in order to address the causes of the Boston Massacre.

options.label: H
options.text: Colonists were opposed to colonial laws being created only by Parliament.

options.label: J
options.text: Colonists wanted to expand powers given to governors appointed by King George III.

visual_elements: Resolved, that the taxation of the people by themselves, or by persons chosen by themselves to represent them . . . is the only security against a burdensome taxation . . . —Virginia Stamp Act Resolutions, May 30, 1765
